method: On the unchanged 28 validation records, reload the immutable failed fp16 layer2 checkpoint and exact passing layers0-1 prefix. Compare four read-only outputs against the same source-layer target: fitted attention plus the complete diagnostic source MLP, an oracle projection of the required residual into the stored rank768 basis, the stored full-feature linear coefficient map alone, and the deployed routed linear-plus-sparse map. Report block-relative RMSE, full-output cosine, absolute RMSE, output-relative RMSE, output/input/residual scales, and residual cosine.
decision_rule: Do not train or write a checkpoint. If exact source MLP and the rank768 oracle pass while learned coefficient decoders fail, the measured bottleneck is coefficient generalization. If the basis oracle fails, the measured bottleneck is the fixed residual basis or its numerical representation. If exact source MLP fails, the measured bottleneck is attention/interface quality. Only the observed category may authorize one separately preregistered repair.
claim_boundary: Preregistered read-only layer2 failure decomposition only; no repair, artifact, English quality, physical runtime, Phase 3 certificate, or ABI superiority claim.
